# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 1 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** PSO 1 | **Agents:** EMET / LOGOS / PNEUMA / SOPHIA

---

**Total disagreements:** 4

**1. 1:1**
EMET: 'when the sinners assailed [us]' (plural implied). LOGOS/SOPHIA: 'when sinners set upon me' / 'when sinners assailed me' (singular). PNEUMA: 'when sinners swarmed over me' (vivid plural). Verdict: singular more consistent with psalm's first-person voice.

**2. 1:2**
EMET/LOGOS: render as reported speech ('He will hear me'). PNEUMA: more vivid ('am I not righteous before him?'). Structural variation in representing the psalmist's self-confidence.

**3. 1:4**
EMET: 'Their glory [reached] unto the ends of the earth.' LOGOS: 'their glory extended to the ends of the earth.' PNEUMA: 'their name rang out to the farthest shores.' PNEUMA diverges with 'name' vs. 'glory' (Greek doxa).

**4. 1:8**
EMET: 'transgressions surpassed those of the nations.' LOGOS: 'lawless deeds exceeded those of the heathen.' PNEUMA: 'lawlessness eclipsed all the nations.' Three different metaphors for exceeding: surpass / exceed / eclipse.

---
